device.name: ADwin Gold II real-time controller (QCoDeS ADwin_Gold2)

facts.text: ADwin_Gold2 is the QCoDeS Instrument class for the ADwin Gold II
The constructor takes the instrument name, a boot file, a process file and an ADwin number that defaults to 1
The constructor opens ADwin.ADwin(adwin_no), boots it, loads and starts the process and clears both FIFOs
process_load stops the process, loads the process file, sets a 3000-step process delay (10 us on the T11 clock) and starts the process
set_outputs builds the FIFO from the mode, input mask, output mask, ramp size and subsampling, then appends the targets; it does not reset the outputs to 0 V
set_outputs_one_cycle sends the FIFO with a one-point ramp, waits two process durations and restores the ramp size
launch_measurement sends the FIFO and sleeps for ramp_size times the process duration
go_to_zero sets the output mask to all eight outputs, commands 0 V on all eight, sends one cycle, restores the mask and clears both FIFOs
read_inputs reads all values in the measurement FIFO at once
clear_fifos clears FIFO 1 and FIFO 2
volt_to_binary returns int(V / 10 * 2**15 + 2**15) as the DAC binary representation
binary_to_volt converts the ADC binary back to a voltage between -10 V and +10 V
set_mode accepts an integer mode or the strings normal, lockin, lockin2 and lockin2_inv
set_output_mask accepts a mask integer or a list of output indices and sums 2**(i-1) for each list index
set_input_mask accepts a mask integer or a list of input indices and sums 2**(i-1) for each list index
set_ramp_size and get_ramp_size read and write the internal ramp size rs
set_subsampling and get_subsampling read and write the subsampling factor
The adwin_mode validator accepts 0x0 through 0x80010 or the four mode names
FIFO_SZ is 1000000
The ramp_size validator is Numbers(0, FIFO_SZ)
The subsampling validator is Numbers(0, 2**16)
The output_mask validator accepts 0b1 through 0b11111111 or a list of indices 1 to 8
The input_mask validator accepts 0b0 through 0b11111111111111 or a list of indices 1 to 14
The outputs Parameter has unit V and the validator Arrays(-10, 10)
The inputs Parameter has unit V and converts each FIFO value with binary_to_volt
The lock-in frequency, amplitude, bandwidth and port Parameters call self.device.Set_FPar, Get_FPar, Set_Par and Get_Par directly
The README says the repository holds custom drivers for instruments used with QCoDeS
The README says the ADwin relies on the nanoqt submodule and the external ADwin package must be installed
.gitmodules declares the submodule adwin/nanoqt
adwin_zero.py boots the ADwin from ./nanoqt/ressources and loads the process ./nanoqt/ressources/acquisition-gold2.TB1
acqui_adwin.py writes one command into FIFO 1, then queues n_ramp pairs of ramp commands in a loop and a final command, all with SetFifo_Long
get_input_size divides ramp_size by subsampling

operator_required.name: subsampling
operator_required.reason: the validator Numbers(0, 2**16) at ADwin_Gold2.py:600 is not a usable range: 0 divides by zero in get_input_size (:825) and the clone does not show what the real-time process accepts

safe_state.description: none proven: the e-stop sends go_to_zero (a 0 V command for all eight outputs written into FIFO 1, then both FIFOs cleared, with no acknowledgement or read-back; the process that executes it is not in the clone) and reports SAFE_STATE_UNREACHED with the latch held; the real-time process keeps running
